designReview.evidence: 2026-09-28 independent review explicitly re-scored D01-01 through D01-06 at 78/80=97.5; Q01-Q06 and Q08-Q21 pass except Q07 partial; Q17 is outside the generation rubric. The course-by-course Q16 table and each lesson's §17 define current scope.

criteria.evidence: The selected D01 source §§1-3 name its S-01 design commission, learner cohort, prerequisites, objective and output.
The selected D01 source §§3, 4 and 7 map student choices to observable task-specific output and revision evidence.
The selected D01 source §3 specifies nine PBL stages and six functions; §17 retains pbl-studio and the same map.
The selected D01 source §10 defines portfolioInput, portfolioOutput, nextUse and conceptRevisit.
The selected D01 source §§1-2 and 11 label S-01 fiction, M examples, R facts and claims not tested.
The selected D01 source §11 maps Blender/OpenAI primary sources to bounded claims and explicitly limits inference.
The independent review records grade-level readability and 30-minute/17-minute classroom timing as unpiloted planning assumptions; the selected D01 source §12 forbids runtime claims.
The selected D01 source §4 defines two student-directed state-changing interactions; §17 assigns deterministic I1/I2 locally.
The selected D01 source §4 gives misconception-specific hints, retry conditions and observable evidence for both interactions.
The selected D01 source §3 includes a changed-context transfer challenge and §7 requires a reasoned design decision.
The selected D01 source §§3-4 diagnose a task-specific misconception and distinguish visual inspection from false technical validation.
The selected D01 source §4 feedback responds to learner evidence and gives a targeted follow-up before retry.
The selected D01 source §§7 and 10 preserve versioned output, task-specific observation and learner revision rationale.
The selected D01 source §§8 and 12 separate coach, Blender operator, student designer and actual peer roles.
The selected D01 source §§4, 6 and 12 keep design choice and acceptance with the learner; AI executes only the instructed Blender work.
The selected D01 source language sections contain separate HK Traditional, Simplified and English reading plus authored Cantonese, Mandarin and English speech; no cross-fallback.
The selected D01 source §14 defines keyboard/mobile task requirements; browser QA separately verifies deterministic workbenches at 390x844 and desktop keyboard.
The selected D01 source §§10 and 17 fail closed on school tool approval, age terms, data flow, sandbox, supervision and rollback; hosted candidate contains no student records.
The selected D01 source §§10-11 require original authored text/assets and use technical sources only as bounded research, not copied media.
The selected D01 source §8 differentiates its project mechanics; §17 maps hosted/local features narrowly and turns off web, image, video and hosted TTS.

scripts/lib/d01-local-components.mjs, tests/scripts/d01-local-components.test.mjs (4/4), scripts/qa-d01-component-templates.mjs (six mobile cases plus desktop keyboard; zero errors/external requests), and reviews/D01-component-qa-2026-09-28.md provide reproducible implementation, unit and browser evidence.

openIssues: This review authorizes only one hosted generation candidate for D01-01. Its link may be accessible to anyone who has it; this does not authorize sharing, learner-site import or publication.
Audio synthesis/listening, OpenMAIC candidate rendering, student trials, school service terms/data-flow/sandbox evidence and classroom timing remain unverified.
All Blender execution claims must remain tied to actual school-approved operator evidence; the local workbench only stores learner input and handoff drafts.
